comment: Other hosts of an archive, tried in order when its pinned address fails with a timeout, a dropped connection, a 5xx or a 429. Every pinned input's SHA-256 is checked after download (archive_inputs.py), so a mirror can only give the pinned bytes or fail; any mirror that keeps the archive's own path layout is safe. A pinned address is rewritten only when it starts with an archive's prefix. Independent operators come first: ftp.debian.org and security.debian.org are served by the same CDN as deb.debian.org. GNU mirrors are listed by https://www.gnu.org/prep/ftp.html.
